channel.title: Davis Community Calendar — new events
channel.description: Events newly added to the calendar, most recent first.

item.title: Bilingual Storytime / Hora de Cuentos (South Davis) — Tue Sep 1, 5:30 PM — South Davis Montgomery Library
item.description:
Join us on most Tuesdays from 5:30 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. to enjoy stories, songs, movements, rhymes, fingerplays, and a craft in Spanish and English. Geared for children from 0 to 5 years old and their parents or caregivers. All ages are welcome.
*Bilingual Storytime is cancelled on September 29.
Acompáñanos la mayoría de los martes de 5:30 p.m. a 6:30 p.m. para disfrutar de cuentos, canciones, movimientos, rimas, juegos con los dedos y una manualidad en español e inglés. Dirigido a niños de 0 a 5 años y sus padres o cuidadores.
*La Hora de Cuentos está cancelada el 29 de septiembre.
Source: Yolo Library

item.title: Disappeared in America Visibility Event - Davis (1st Wednesday) — Wed Sep 2, 4:30 PM — Near City Hall at the intersection of Fifth & B Sts
item.description:
In America, the government doesn’t get to grab people off the streets, skip the courtroom, and send them straight to a foreign prison. Disappeared in America is a Yolo County day of action to stand up for the rule of law and confront the Trump administration’s illegal abductions, detentions, and deportations of people like Kilmar Abrego Garcia, Rui Marras, and Juan Maldonado Zuniga. 🚨 On the 1st Wednesday of the month, we’re showing up in Davis near City Hall at the intersection of 5th & B St. B
Source: Indivisible Yolo (Mobilize)

item.title: Woodland CA Visibility Brigade Thursdays over Highway 113 — Thu Sep 3, 8:00 AM — Sports Park Bridge
item.description:
Join the Woodland Visibility Brigade to make the Resistance VISIBLE! We resist the authoritarian and fascist administration with a topical message and publicize upcoming local resistance events. We dance and wave and get lots of friendly honks! You will receive an immediate confirmation email with parking and location details, and a reminder one hour beforehand. Please make sure you know where you're headed before you set out!

item.description:

Source: Yolo Library

item.title: Woodland Activist Circle Monthly Meeting — Wed Sep 9, 5:00 PM — Yolo Branch Library Community Room
item.description:
Join local activists to take action for change! Fight the Trump regime by joining our Woodland Activist Circle. We meet at the spacious and well-appointed community room at the County Library in Yolo, California. The hamlet of Yolo is just a short six-mile drive up Interstate 5. Bring your picnic dinner and a lawn chair if you'd like to stay for a social hour at 7:00. Orientation for newcomers will be included. This event is not sponsored by Yolo County Library and the presence of Indivisible Yo
Source: Indivisible Yolo (Mobilize)

item.title: Register Voters at UC Davis — Mon Sep 21, 11:30 AM — UCD Quad
item.description:
Join Indivisible Yolo in registering voters for the 2026 elections! Democracy functions best when people engage in conversations about what needs to be done. On campus at UCD on Wednesday, we don't start by pushing a form. Using the Field Team 6 model, we ask questions and talk about problems that need to be addressed. We talk about how voting can be a way to get decision makers who will address those problems. Then we make sure they have everything they need to vote on November 3. You can join
Source: Indivisible Yolo (Mobilize)

item.title: Free Yoga Practice — Thu Sep 24, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community 🌀 **Move with intention. Connect with your body. Celebrate community.**
Join us every **Thursday at 6 PM** for an embodied yoga practice designed to help you release tension, ground yourself, and cultivate presence. This is a trauma-informed, all-levels class, no prior yoga experience needed. Expect a Hatha-Vinyasa flow, breathwork, and a space to listen to your body’s wisdom.
🌿 **Every last Thursday of the month, stay after class for a community potluck dinner!**
📍 **Location**: 727 T St. Sacramento CA 95811 ✨ **All our events are free. Donations are welcome.** 📩 **Questions? Reach out at** embody.iama@gmail.com 🔗 **Follow us on Instagram:** [@embody.iama](https://www.instagram.com/embody.iama)
Source: Meetup: Mindful Embodied Spirituality
